title: Remove login/logout button from header

requirements.text: Remove the login/logout button located at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/header[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[1]/button[1] from the Header component
acceptanceCriteria: The login/logout button is no longer visible in the header
The header layout adjusts appropriately without the button
Internet Identity authentication hooks remain available for other components if needed

constraints: Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or other authentication infrastructure
Preserve the admin link functionality in the header for authenticated admins
nonGoals: Removing Internet Identity provider or authentication system entirely
Changing header styling beyond removing the button
